import numpy as np

def select_next_node(graph, unvisited_nodes):
    pre = graph.graph.get('precomputed', {})
    max_core = pre.get('max_core_k', 1)
    bridge_ratio = pre.get('bridge_ratio_high_bc', 0.1)
    degree_variance = pre.get('degree_variance', 0)
    apl_lcc = pre.get('apl_lcc', 1)
    diameter_lcc = pre.get('diameter_lcc', 1)
    avg_degree = pre.get('avg_degree', 1)

    degs = np.array([graph.nodes[n]['degree'] for n in unvisited_nodes], dtype=float)
    betw = np.array([graph.nodes[n]['betweenness'] for n in unvisited_nodes], dtype=float)
    core = np.array([graph.nodes[n]['core_number'] for n in unvisited_nodes], dtype=float)
    eig = np.array([graph.nodes[n]['eigenvector'] for n in unvisited_nodes], dtype=float)
    cluster = np.array([graph.nodes[n]['clustering'] for n in unvisited_nodes], dtype=float)

    def norm(x):
        rng = x.max() - x.min()
        return (x - x.min()) / rng if rng > 1e-12 else np.zeros_like(x)

    deg_n = norm(degs)
    betw_n = norm(betw)
    core_n = norm(core)
    eig_n = norm(eig)
    cluster_n = norm(cluster)

    inv_eig_n = 1 - eig_n
    inv_cluster_n = 1 - cluster_n

    # New weight assignments prioritizing inverse eigenvector and inverse clustering strongly,
    # moderate betweenness and degree, and less core influence
    w_inv_eig = 0.35 * (1 + diameter_lcc / (diameter_lcc + 1))
    w_inv_clust = 0.30 * (1 + bridge_ratio)
    w_betw = 0.20 * (1 + 1 / (apl_lcc + 1))
    w_deg = 0.10 * (1 + degree_variance)
    w_core = 0.05 * (1 + max_core / (max_core + 1))

    weights = np.array([w_inv_eig, w_inv_clust, w_betw, w_deg, w_core])
    weights /= weights.sum()

    score = (w_inv_eig * inv_eig_n +
             w_inv_clust * inv_cluster_n +
             w_betw * betw_n +
             w_deg * deg_n +
             w_core * core_n)

    # Local fragmentation proxy: sum of neighbors' inverse clustering (favoring nodes with neighbors in sparse areas)
    neighbors_dict = {n: set(graph.neighbors(n)) & set(unvisited_nodes) for n in unvisited_nodes}
    neighbor_inv_clust_sum = np.array([
        sum((1 - graph.nodes[nei]['clustering']) for nei in neighbors_dict[n]) for n in unvisited_nodes
    ], dtype=float)
    neighbor_inv_clust_norm = norm(neighbor_inv_clust_sum)

    # Adaptive alpha favoring local fragmentation more in graphs with higher diameter and bridge ratio
    alpha = np.clip(0.3 + 0.5 * (diameter_lcc / (diameter_lcc + 10)) * bridge_ratio, 0.4, 0.7)

    final_scores = alpha * score + (1 - alpha) * neighbor_inv_clust_norm

    max_idx = np.argmax(final_scores)
    next_node = unvisited_nodes[max_idx]

    return next_node
